name: Sun Cleric: the server supplies the Solar Power buff and the Dawn spell the client's resource orb reads (#323)
contract: The Solar Power orb is drawn by the CoA client, not the server. Interface/FrameXML/Ascension_CoAResources/ClassResources.lua (patch-B.MPQ) gives the SUNCLERIC branch ClassMixin.minLevel = 2 and its OnPlayerAura hides CoAResourceOrb unless IsSpellIDKnown(804584); when shown, the orb reads AuraUtil.GetBuff('player', 500149) stacks against GetSpellMaxStack(500149) (Ascension_SunClericResource.lua calls SetSpellID(500149)). Spell.dbc: 804584 is Dawn (BaseLevel 2), a level-2 Sun Cleric class grant (AscensionCustomClassData ClassSpells {27, 2, 804584}); 500149 Solar Power is a caster aura with StackAmount 20 and no negative attribute. Vow of Radiance 803489 (BaseLevel 2): 'Direct ability damage or healing generates 2 Solar Power'. Illumination 500143 (level 1) is a direct SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL on an ally; it is cast on a wounded second player so the heal is effective and the caster is not also its target. Expected server side: a new level-1 Sun Cleric does not know Dawn (so the client hides the orb at level 1, which is what #323 reports from a level-1 character); once a level-2 cleric knows Dawn and heals under Vow of Radiance, it holds exactly 2 stacks of a helpful 500149 aura, the one buff the orb reads. Rendering of the orb itself is client UI and outside this harness.

steps.label: A new level-1 Sun Cleric does not know Dawn, so the client's orb gate stays closed
SETUP: no Solar Power before any Vow
The level-2 cleric knows Dawn, the spell the client's orb requires
SETUP: Vow of Radiance is active
Let the Vow's global cooldown expire
Leave room for an effective heal
Direct heal on an ally under Vow of Radiance
Vow of Radiance: the direct heal generates 2 Solar Power
Solar Power is a helpful aura, which is what the orb's AuraUtil.GetBuff reads
